JAPANAichi Prefecture & Nagoya City

The Games at a glance

The 5th Asian Para Games bring athletes from across Asia together for a week of high-level para-sport competition in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. Dates: October 18–24, 2026. Host area: Aichi Prefecture and Nagoya City, Japan. Opening ceremony: October 18 at 6:00 PM JST (3:00 PM Bangladesh time). Competition venues vary by sport.

📅

Dates & Updates

The Games run Sunday, October 18 through Saturday, October 24, 2026. The opening ceremony is scheduled for October 18 at 6:00 PM Japan Standard Time (3:00 PM Bangladesh time). Confirm the latest schedule on the official website.

🏟️

Competition Schedule

Competitions take place across multiple venues in Aichi Prefecture and Nagoya City. Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium is the main venue for the ceremonies; check the official venue map for each sport and the latest results.
